I want a refund.", "verified_identity": true}'::jsonb);for j in 1..3 loop perform public.novacart_record_failure(jsonb_build_object('ticket_id',v->>'ticket_id','message','injected'));perform public.novacart_retry_case((v->>'ticket_id')::uuid);end loop;perform public.novacart_record_failure(jsonb_build_object('ticket_id',v->>'ticket_id','message','injected'));perform pg_temp.expect_error('select public.novacart_retry_case('||quote_literal(v->>'ticket_id')||'::uuid)');

name: Empty semantic store returns no false hits
sql: r:=public.novacart_retrieve(('['||array_to_string(array_fill(0.01::float,array[1536]),',')||']')::extensions.vector);perform pg_temp.check_true(jsonb_array_length(r->'policies')=0,'empty index honest');
